mapper.select: SELECT rent_ctrt_no FROM rent_ctrt WHERE user_no = #{userNo} ORDER BY reg_dt DESC FETCH FIRST 1 ROWS ONLY

SELECT sd.sbmsn_doc_no ,sd.sbmsn_doc_ty_cd ,sd.sbmsn_doc_stts_cd ,sd.rjct_rsn_cn ,sd.atch_file_id ,sd.rent_ctrt_no ,rc.ctrt_stts_cd FROM sbmsn_doc sd INNER JOIN rent_ctrt rc ON sd.rent_ctrt_no = rc.rent_ctrt_no WHERE rc.user_no = #{userNo} ORDER BY sd.reg_dt DESC
SELECT rl.rent_lstg_no FROM rent_listing rl INNER JOIN apt_detail ad ON rl.ho_no = ad.ho_no INNER JOIN apt_unit au ON ad.dong_no = au.dong_no WHERE au.apt_cmplex_no = #{aptCmplexNo} AND ROWNUM = 1
